notes.title: Play USBB with Steam Remote Play Together
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33591918/bb91a7e58e9d9d2fdf0d420e8290e3248d5c9c35.png[/img]

[i]"I want to play this game with my friends, but they're so far away..."

"Will there be online multiplayer for this game?"[/i]

[h1]GOOD NEWS FROM STEAM![/h1]
Now in Beta! you can now invite up to 3 Steam Friends to join your Ultra Space Battle Brawl game online. [u]Only the host needs to own and install the game,[/u] while additional players connect through Steam Remote Play streaming technology.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH IT!
[list]
[*] Play USBB with Steam Friends online
[*] Stream video, audio, input, and voice between players
[*] Use your own controllers, or share control of the keyboard & mouse
[*] Play together across PC and Mac
[/list]

[h1]HOW DOES IT WORK?[/h1]
[b]1. Launch your game.[/b] Join Steam Beta, then launch any of your local multiplayer games.

[b]2. Invite your friends.[/b] From your Friends list in the Steam Overlay, select Remote Play Together. Once they accept...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33591918/51f7d510ece51936360460c0ce4d36c23616bf7c.gif[/img]

[b]3. You're playing together.[/b]


Their controllers will act as if they're plugged directly into your computer, and all your voice chat and game volume options are available in one place. You can share — or limit access to — the keyboard and mouse. It’s your choice.

Go to the link below to learn more about Steam Remote Play Together!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687[/url]

Now invite your friends and get ready [i][b]to SMASH!!![/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/658500/Ultra_Space_Battle_Brawl/
